liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Althea** (3 reviews): Reviewer's first Althea, and the one they enjoyed most; Reviewer says the jam at the end of Althea is sweet, with Jerry leaving the crowd gasping [13][18][19]
- **Uncle John's Band** (1 review, 1 other source): Reviewer praises Uncle John's Band and calls the show very jammy; Uploader notes an interesting jam coming out of Uncle John's Band [5][17]
- **Morning Dew** (2 reviews): Reviewer praises the Morning Dew; This was the reviewer's first show with a Dew; their next three shows also had one [17][18]
- **They Love Each Other** (1 review): Reviewer enjoyed hearing They Love Each Other [16]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Reviewer found the Let It Grow strong [13]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 review): Playing, Uncle John's Band, then Playing again confused the reviewer, who thought they had already heard it [18]
- **Turn On Your Lovelight** (1 review): Reviewer says Lovelight was rocking [21]
- **Handsome Cabin Boy** (1 review): Reviewer says Handsome Cabin Boy comes out of Space, not Two Soldiers [17]

## Setlist highlights

- **Handsome Cabin Boy Jam**: back after 223 archived shows (1086 days); rare: 3 archived performances [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-09-12.158747.ultramatrix.miller.flac2496** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 165 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1990-09-12.161422.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: soundboard; 19 songs; 165 min [2]
- **gd90-09-12.schoeps.fishman.13141.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 19 songs; 168 min; rated 3.88/5 by 8 [4]
- **gd1990-09-12.146065.FOB.BK4011.Brotman.Metchick.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: source not stated; 19 songs; 172 min [5]. Said about its sound: A mic bump and two dropouts in the first set were repaired [5]
- **gd90-09-12.set1-sbd.wiley.8818.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 9 songs; 64 min; rated 3.4/5 by 5 [9]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the set one soundboard sounds good; The set one soundboard file cuts off midway through Big River, for this reviewer [13][15]

## Around the show

- Reviewer recalls Eddie Brickel opening, with rain and lightning flashing around the stage during the show [10]
- Reviewer, also at the Spectrum, says there was no rain, no lightning and no Eddie Brickell [11]
- Reviewer attended and did not see Eddie at the show [16]
- Reviewer remembers a man circling the floor with arms raised, eyes closed, swaying through the crowd [21]
- Reviewer recalls a good post-show parking lot scene and drum circle [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-09-12.158747.ultramatrix.miller.flac2496**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  November 23, 2022; source: Ultramatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-X90) [1]
- **gd1990-09-12.161422.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  November 23, 2022; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [2]. Also: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy, with a Dave Brotman patch; converted from 24-bit/96k FLAC down to 16-bit/44.1k [2]
- **gd90-09-12.schoeps.fishman.13141.sbeok.shnf**: source: Schoeps MK4V> DAT> CD-R>WAV>SHN. [4]. Also: Schoeps MK4V microphones to DAT, then CD-R, EAC, and SHN, circulated via JR Fishman [4]
- **gd1990-09-12.146065.FOB.BK4011.Brotman.Metchick.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: taped by Dave Brotman & Jeff Metchick Master Digital Recording; transferred by Charlie Miller Transfer Edited & Mastered by Joe Noel; source: Recording info: B&K 4011 (110°) > B&K power supply > Master DAT (Panasonic SV-250/48k) Location: FOB, Sec 102, Row 15 (s1) Row 14 (s2), Seat 13 (mics on stand… [5]
- **gd90-09-12.set1-sbd.wiley.8818.sbeok.shnf**: source: Set 1 (Healy Mix) SBD> ?> CDR>WAV>SHN [9]
